6376.title: Preserve inline-code provenance when copying file references
6376.rootCauseOneLine: Inline-code file auto-linking discards code provenance, so clipboard serialization emits links or bare paths instead of code spans.
6376.proposedFix: Mark anchors synthesized from inline code and serialize them with the existing codeSpan formatter before normal link handling.
6376.caveats: Clipboard handler reproduced in two clean jsdom checkouts; historical release timing and live browser/OS clipboard were not tested. Regression patch and output are inline under public-report artifact restrictions.
